title: Trilife Official Modpack
description: The official modpack used on the Trilife SMP
body:
# Trilife Official Modpack
The Trilife Official Modpack is a modpack made for the Trilife SMP, a project heavily inspired from Grian's life series.
This modpack aims at providing the best possible functionality for playing the SMP.
To get started, simply install this modpack, create a new world and type `/trilife init`.
## Features
### Totems
The Trilife mod adds a large variety of totems, replacing the basic Totem of Undying. All of these have unique crafting recipes and functionalities.
### Life System
Each player gets assigned three lives. When a player dies, they loose a heart. When a player reaches zero hearts, they are put in spectator mode.
### Performance
Using the Sodium mod, as well as many other mods, this modpack will improove your FPS quite a bit. Reportedly, Sodium alone is able to increase FPS up to three times the regular vanilla FPS.
### Voice Chat
We are using the Simple Voice Chat mod for in-game proximity voice chat. This allows you to communicate with players reallistically and hastle-free.
### Much more!
Listing all the features from all of the mods would take forever. But be assured, just in the Trilife mod alone there are many more suprises waiting!
## Known Bugs
- Essential-hosted worlds experience large lag spikes when auto-saving.
- The 'Player Ghosts' feature from Trilife sometimes fails to remove a ghost on Essential-hosted worlds.
## Disclaimer
This modpack contains proprietary-licensed mods, thus we can't know how these mods will handle your data.
